name: Honeygain
connection: Permitted fixed broadband; native phone data is a separate Android route. PC mobile tethering is prohibited.
caveat: Demand-based credits; PayPal India conditions apply. One pooled row per account. Indicative rate is not predicted traffic.

name: ProxyRack Peer
connection: Windows supported; verify actual carrier/network permission, IP classification and dashboard payout terms.
caveat: India provider invitation; paid traffic only. Residential/datacenter classification changes rates. Minimum must be verified, not guessed.

name: PacketStream
connection: One Windows sharing client per public IP; confirm current India and connection eligibility.
caveat: $0.10 per routed GB before fees. No traffic forecast; first withdrawal time gate and local PayPal availability matter.

name: Bitping
connection: Windows network jobs; low system requirements. India job demand and redemption unproven.
caveat: No fixed earning rate. Crypto payout and wallet costs need review; default income is unknown.

name: ByteLixir
connection: Windows / Android with eligible connection; actual IP type and country demand control.
caveat: Crypto-only route. Published rate is not demand. Do not count Windows and Android pooled balances twice.

name: EarnFM
connection: Wi-Fi / fixed broadband required; current help excludes cellular-only sharing.
caveat: Approved payouts through Tremendous; India redemption and actual rate need checking. No native-SIM allocation.

name: Repocket
connection: Windows client verified. Current India eligibility, rate and minimum are dashboard-dependent.
caveat: Variable provisional earnings and possible holds; budget unknown until measured and redeemed.

name: TraffMonetizer
connection: Windows / legitimate assigned-IP environments; confirm own network and India eligibility.
caveat: No verified public earning rate. USDT network and conversion costs require a usable withdrawal path.

name: UserTesting
connection: Windows PC, supported display/microphone/upload; country admission checked during signup.
caveat: Paid feedback requires human qualification and work; test availability variable. No scripted answers or assumed monthly tests.

name: uTest
connection: Windows browser/app testing and real phone coverage; project invitation and accepted work required.
caveat: Human testing, not background income. Record only accepted paid work; setup and Academy time are not wages.

name: Test IO
connection: PC/phone manual testing with onboarding and project-specific rules.
caveat: Accepted bugs and reproductions drive rewards. No guaranteed bug volume or pay-per-hour.

name: Clickworker
connection: PC tasks plus required smartphone app/2FA; country/task availability varies.
caveat: Qualification and manual accepted tasks. Some project payments have substantial delays; keep cash separate from accrual.

name: Scoped freelance service
connection: Browser-based client work on an existing skill; use a legitimate platform and payment process.
caveat: Needs buyers and delivery. Fees, revisions and acquisition time reduce take-home; client scope is not a passive app.

name: Userlytics
connection: PC microphone/browser and task-specific recorder; truthful practice and screening. India admission checked during signup.
caveat: Active UX feedback. PayPal-supported country rule; approved tests only, unpredictable invitations. Owner does the actual feedback.

name: Respondent
connection: Browser/video interviews; India is a recruiting market, but selection is study-specific.
caveat: Unpaid screeners; confirmed study completion required. 5%/$1 minimum fee per incentive. Tremendous regional gift cards are not automatically PayPal/cash; keep cash field zero for vouchers.

name: OneForma
connection: Browser-based project marketplace; actual country, language, equipment and qualification from each current listing.
caveat: India language projects exist, not a guaranteed job. General payout threshold unverified; confirm current dashboard method before working. No AI qualification substitution.

name: CrowdGen
connection: Apply for a real project; shortlisted owner completes account, security, qualification and payment setup.
caveat: Project-specific work/rates. Hours or units need invoice approval; payment methods depend on account/country. No platform-wide hourly wage or payout forecast.

name: Adobe Stock contributor
connection: Create original rights-cleared assets on existing tools, submit for review, then track actual licenses/royalties.
caveat: Creation first, possible future royalties; not bandwidth income. $25 plus 45 days since first sale for payout eligibility; verify current local provider/tax setup. No assumed license sales.

name: Gumroad original digital products
connection: Create an original useful template or asset; verify India seller payout eligibility before publishing.
caveat: Creation/marketing work with possible future sales. Verify country-specific minimum, fees and holds. Gross product sales are not take-home, and publishing creates no buyer demand.
